<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
Press **📊 Reports** on the officer panel (set it up on the **Panels** tab of `/guild-settings show`). It needs **Open the reports**, which officers have. The reports open **only for the person who pressed**, so several officers can read different ones at once.

A reports panel posted with the old `/reports` command keeps working, but the command is gone: the officer panel replaces it.

## Attendance

**📊 Attendance** shows who has been turning up, three ways:

- **By member**: each player's attendances and their share of the events held, with their most-attended event types. **Fewest first** turns the list round.
- **By event type**: how many events of each type were held, the average turnout, and the best and lowest.
- **Week by week**: attendances each week as a bar, to see the trend.

Pick the period (7, 30 or 90 days, or all history) and one event type, or every type. Only events whose attendance was saved count, so an event that never records attendance does not make everyone look absent. The free plan looks back 30 days; paid plans see all history and can **📄 Export CSV** of any of the three.

## Past events

**📜 Past events** lists the events that have ended, newest first, with how many signed up and how many attended. Pick the period and an event type, then **Open an event…** to see its sign-ups as they were (each answer, and on a role-slot event who was in a slot and who was on the bench) and who attended, with who recorded it and when.

It reads Alagos's records, not the channel, so it still works after the event's messages are removed (see **After an event ends** in Running events). The free plan looks back 30 days; paid plans see all history and can **📄 Export CSV** of an event.

## Everyday reports

- **💤 Who's gone quiet**: active players (not on leave) grouped by how long since their last confirmed attendance: never, 60+ days, 30–59 days and 14–29 days, with the date and the days since. Players seen in the last 14 days are just counted.

## For officers

- **📅 What's scheduled**: the next 7 days of events and the health of each repeating event. It flags anything that did not post or is missing its reminders, and **🔧 Re-arm** fixes those. Needs **Manage events**.

In a server playing DC Dark Legion, the panel also has its Gotham, Krypton Rush, train and Guardian reports: see [**DC Dark Legion reports**](/guides/dcdl-reports/).

Every report has **◀ Back** to the panel.
